What happens next

A simple process

No long sales process. No large proposal before we know if we are a good fit. Just a clear conversation.

01 / TALK

We learn about your situation

You tell us what is happening, what is not working and where you want your business to go.

02 / PLAN

We suggest the right next step

We look at the systems, tools and support your business needs. Then we explain the best way forward in simple words.

03 / BUILD

We get to work

Once we agree on the plan, we build, set up, improve and support the technology your business depends on.

Before you contact us

Questions are welcome

Here are answers to a few common questions.

What kind of businesses do you work with?+

We work with growing businesses that need help with websites, security, email, cloud tools, automation, software and ongoing IT support.

Do I need to know exactly what I need?+

No. You only need to explain the problem or goal. We will help you understand what needs to be done.

Can you support an existing website or system?+

Yes. We can review, fix, improve and manage websites and systems built by another provider.

Do you offer ongoing support?+

Yes. We offer monthly support for businesses that want one team to manage their important technology.

Where are you based?+

We are based in Kumasi, Ghana, and support businesses across Ghana and West Africa.

Your outsourced IT department for growing businesses in Ghana and West Africa. One monthly retainer. One accountable team. The technology your business depends on, properly managed.
